correctness.rationale: For every q>=2,n>=3, equality constraints on forests produce marginal binomial variables and pairwise cross-indicator independence. Conditional on adjacent equality indicators, two-step equality has the three stated local probabilities, giving the exact finite regression. The centered pair-orthogonality identity yields ratio 2/[(q-1)(n-1)], and triangle expectations give third moment. Eighteen full finite word-space censuses passed all exact assertions; no inference of infinite truth is drawn from enumeration.

value.rationale: Lag-one and lag-two matching counts are natural word-process statistics. Their universal zero linear covariance hides strictly positive predictable nonlinear variation; an exact all-parameter quadratic projection and sharp explained-variance law quantify that gap and its decay, including perfect nonlinear prediction in the binary length-three boundary case. This addresses a structural statistical dependence rather than an arbitrary chosen finite statistic.
